command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null; echo source_head=$(git rev-parse origin/main); SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test "$SERIAL" = RFCT70L7E8J; echo serial=$SERIAL; echo pid_now=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); echo '--- exit-info ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity exit-info io.blueeye 2>/dev/null | head -n 220 || true; echo '--- recent-crash-logcat ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v threadtime -t 5000 2>/dev/null | grep -E -i 'AndroidRuntime|FATAL EXCEPTION|io\.blueeye|OutOfMemoryError|TransactionTooLargeException|SIG(SEGV|ABRT|KILL)|lmkd|low memory|am_crash|Process .*io\.blueeye|DatabaseExporter|Preparing session export|Unable to share session export' | tail -n 500 || true; echo 'PHASE3_SHARE_CRASH_CAPTURE_DONE'
